scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag to review the order.
Confirmed that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Proceeded to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully; order TS-8874 was confirmed and €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag page.
Confirmed the initial order summary showed €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The updated order summary showed free shipping and a €51.00 total.

steps.remark: navigate: Navigate to http://localhost:4173/
click: Clicking Add House Espresso and opening the bag
scroll: Scrolling into view for Add Paper Filters to bag
click: Clicking Add Paper Filters to bag and opening the bag
scroll: Scrolling to the Bag (2) section
click: Clicking Bag (2) to open the bag
analyze: the total is €49.40.
assert: shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40.
click: Clicking Add one more Paper Filters under Paper Filters row
analyze: the total is €51.00.
assert: shipping is now Free and the total is €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The promotion was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.

fix.summary: FREE_SHIPPING_FROM was set to 50, but the code compares it with integer cents, so orders of €0.50 or more shipped free; it is now 50 * 100 cents (€50).
